channel: GitHub / open-source project repositories with permissively licensed demo media (Apache-2.0 / MIT / OpenRAIL-M). Method: blobless git clones of 60+ repos (git tree + README + LICENSE + commit dates), raw.githubusercontent.com / media.githubusercontent.com / github.com/user-attachments downloads with ffprobe, arXiv abs pages and Hugging Face model API for date corroboration. api.github.com was unauthenticated and rate-limited after 3 calls, so the GitHub tree was read through git. NO frames were viewed: every content description comes from README text, prompts encoded in file names, or measured properties (ffprobe, scene-cut detection, seam analysis). Higgsfield video_analysis jobs were queued for 13 clips but none completed before the deadline (ids in notes of the affected candidates). Licence stance: a repo-level code licence is NOT treated as automatic permission for media; every candidate below is 'likely' (never 'clear') and the basis_note states precisely what the argument is and what is missing.
